subject: math
topicName: Statistics - Lesson 10: Statistical Report and Probability Critique
description: Critique statistical reports by checking claims, samples, displays, denominators, probability language, and evidence-based conclusions.
learningObjectives: Identify the claim, evidence, population, sample, and possible bias in a statistical report.
Choose the correct denominator for basic, complement, and conditional probability statements.
Evaluate whether a graph or display uses fair labels, scales, categories, and context.
Write conclusions that are supported by the data without overgeneralizing.
prerequisites: Read two-way tables and simple bar graphs
